author: Discovery
description:
The moonshiners take on some of their most creative spirits yet, crafting Peach Cardamom Rum, Hazelnut Rum, a rye whiskey inspired by George Washington’s original recipe and more! From bold flavors to historic recipes, every batch puts their distilling skills to the test.
#Moonshiners Tuesdays at 8P on #Discovery

Stream Full Episodes of Moonshiners:
https://www.discoveryplus.com/show/moonshiners

About Moonshiners:
Every spring, a fearless group of men and women venture deep into the woods of Appalachia, defying the law, rivals and nature itself to keep the centuries-old tradition of craft whiskey alive.
